atomicity.reason: One obligation: inhibit traction while a door is not closed and locked.

parent_fit.reason: Inhibiting traction while a door is open prevents the bus moving off during boarding (US_PASSENGER_DOOR_SAFETY).

unambiguity.reason: Whether 'inhibit traction' only blocks moving off from standstill or also cuts traction when a door opens while driving is not stated.
unambiguity.suggestion: Clarify the behaviour while the vehicle is moving.

variant_consistency.reason: Gated var.vehicle.type == 'bus', same as its parent.

verifiability.reason: Testable: with any door not closed and locked, a traction demand produces no traction.
